                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        凑一凑「双11」的热闹，品一品「双11」促销的味道。今年的 11.11，我们联合凌霞软件推出了联合终身会员「双11」促销活动。如果您在 11.11-11.13 期间 购买「博客园 + 1Panel + Halo」联合终身VIP会员，会额外赠送博客园周边与凌霞软件周边各1件
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>凑一凑「双11」的热闹，品一品「双11」促销的味道。</p>
<p>今年的 11.11，我们联合凌霞软件推出了联合终身会员「双11」活动。</p>
<p>如果您在 11.11-11.13 期间 <a href="https://cnblogs.vip/buy" target="_blank">购买</a>「博客园 + <a href="https://www.lxware.cn/1panel" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1Panel</a> + <a href="https://www.lxware.cn/halo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Halo</a>」联合终身VIP会员，会额外赠送博客园周边与凌霞软件周边各1件。</p>
<p><a href="https://cnblogs.vip/buy/lifetime" target="_blank"><img alt="博客园+1Panel+Halo联合终身会员" width="700" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/35695/202511/35695-20251111080857886-1548102762.png" class="lazyload"></a></p>
<p>赠送的博客园周边是卫衣，有2款可选：</p>
<p>注：卫衣是额外赠送，终身会员本来会赠送T恤，实际可以领1件卫衣+1件T恤</p>
<p>1）TALK IS CHEAP 拉链卫衣</p>
<p><a href="https://cnblogs.vip/store/zip-up-hoodie-talk-is-cheap?vid=174" target="_blank"><img alt="" width="400" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1177246/202411/1177246-20241103001332997-918379719.jpg" class="lazyload"></a></p>
<p>2）TALK IS CHEAP 加绒卫衣</p>
<p><a href="https://cnblogs.vip/store/sweat-shirt-talk-is-cheap?vid=114" target="_blank"><img alt="" width="400" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1177246/202411/1177246-20241103135944811-312874650.jpg" class="lazyload"></a></p>
<p>赠送的凌霞软件周边是纯钛露营杯，也有2款可选：</p>
<p>1）1Panel 纯钛露营杯</p>
<p><img alt="1Panel纯钛露营杯" width="600" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/35695/202511/35695-20251110174036509-1328826558.webp" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2）Halo 纯钛露营杯</p>
<p><img alt="Halo纯钛露营杯" width="600" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/35695/202511/35695-20251110174207979-28904891.webp" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>周边领取方式：购买后加 <a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/cmt/articles/17677736.html" target="_blank">博客园企业微信</a> 领取</p>
<p>购买方式：前往 <a href="https://cnblogs.vip/buy" target="_blank">https://cnblogs.vip/buy</a> ，点击「终身 VIP」，加购「1Panel 联合终身会员升级包」与「Halo 联合终身会员升级包」</p>
<p>与此同时，凌霞软件的「1Panel &amp; Halo 双十一大促活动」火热进行中，详见 <a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ka1kai/p/19187842/lxware-1111" target="_blank">1Panel &amp; Halo 双十一大促｜年度钜惠进行时！</a></p>
